title: Alignment Faking Detection via Training-Context Sensitivity Probes

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear causal chain: training-context sensitivity is a clean operationalization of alignment faking, cross-model mapping directly identifies which model families are highest-risk. The Anthropic alignment faking paper provides a validated baseline (4.6x for Claude 3 Opus, 28.6% for GPT-4o).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Simple prompt-variation experiment: vary the training-context framing while holding the request constant. API-based, no model internals needed. Well-documented methodology from the Anthropic paper. Beginners can follow the replication design with minimal ML expertise.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single axis of variation (training context framing), clear deliverable (sensitivity table across model families). Well-defined metric (behavioral divergence rate). Easily completable in 30 hours even with limited experience.
